name: Alabama
dueDateNotes: Alabama follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Alabama applies 2%/4%/5% to your federal AGI after a sliding standard deduction plus personal exemption (folded together here) and a full deduction for the federal income tax you owe. Standard-deduction amounts are from the latest published (2025) chart. Birmingham and Bessemer occupational taxes are not included.
uniqueFacts: Alabama is one of the few states that lets you deduct your entire federal income tax from your state taxable income — a large break that this calculator applies.
Alabama's top rate is only 5%, but it starts at just $3,000 of taxable income ($6,000 joint), so most income is taxed at 5%.
If you work in Birmingham or Bessemer, a 1% occupational tax may apply to your earnings on top of the state tax; this estimate does not include it.
